sql.value: select count(1) as request_count, coalesce(sum(total_tokens), 0) as total_tokens, coalesce(sum(cost), 0) as total_cost, coalesce(avg(latency_ms), 0) as avg_latency, coalesce(sum(case when status = 'success' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as success_count from ai_audit_log where 1 = 1 #[and create_time >= :startTime] #[and create_time <= :endTime]

select date_format(create_time, :dateFormat) as period, coalesce(sum(prompt_tokens), 0) as prompt_tokens, coalesce(sum(completion_tokens), 0) as completion_tokens, coalesce(sum(total_tokens), 0) as total_tokens, coalesce(sum(cost), 0) as cost, count(1) as request_count from ai_audit_log where 1 = 1 #[and create_time >= :startTime] #[and create_time <= :endTime] group by date_format(create_time, :dateFormat) order by period asc

select model_id, max(model_name) as model_name, max(provider_type) as provider_type, count(1) as request_count, coalesce(sum(total_tokens), 0) as total_tokens, coalesce(sum(cost), 0) as cost, coalesce(avg(latency_ms), 0) as avg_latency from ai_audit_log where model_id is not null #[and create_time >= :startTime] #[and create_time <= :endTime] group by model_id order by request_count desc

select l.user_id, max(u.username) as user_name, count(1) as request_count, coalesce(sum(l.total_tokens), 0) as total_tokens, coalesce(sum(l.cost), 0) as cost from ai_audit_log l left join sys_user u on u.id = l.user_id where l.user_id is not null #[and l.create_time >= :startTime] #[and l.create_time <= :endTime] group by l.user_id order by request_count desc
